coreMechanic.summary: No swipe. No match request. Person A taps a profile → chat opens immediately. Calls unlock ONLY when Person B sends their first reply. Enforced server-side — no paid override, no bypass.
coreMechanic.callUnlockRule: conversation.callUnlocked stored server-side. Set TRUE the moment Person B (non-initiator) sends their first message. Client reads this — never computes locally. Call buttons are absent from DOM until flag is true.

callTimeLimits.freeTracking: deducted real-time server-side; call ended server-side when limit reached

gridRankingAlgorithm.important: Ranking NEVER differentiates by gender identity or sexual orientation. Orientation determines WHICH grid — not rank within it.

orientationGridLogic.notes: Grid visibility based on WHO THEY WANT TO SEE and WHO WANTS TO SEE THEM — not orientation label assumptions.
rules: Straight man → grids of women who want to see men
Gay man → grids of men who want to see men
Lesbian woman → grids of women who want to see women
Bisexual → all matching grids by default (filterable)
Trans users → follows gender identity not assigned-at-birth

safetySystem.goldenRule: Calls NEVER available until Person B sends at least one reply. No paid override. No bypass. Call button must not exist in DOM.

callSafety.consecutiveDeclinedBlock: 3 declined in 1 day → 24h block from calling

safetySystem.panicHide: One tap removes profile from entire grid. Reversible. Chats preserved.

notes: Socket.IO: connect with io(baseUrl, {auth:{token}}) — socket joins room user:<id> on connect.
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. Refresh on 401 via /auth/refresh.
Error envelope: {error:string, message:string, details?:any}.
Fuzzy location: API NEVER returns lat/lng to other users — only a rounded distanceLabel ('0.4 km away') or 'Near you' for Gold+ hideExactDistance users.
E2E chat: clients encrypt/decrypt; server stores opaque ciphertext. Translation endpoint is for non-E2E mode only.

CRITICAL — callUnlocked rule: conversation.callUnlocked is stored server-side and set TRUE only when Person B (non-initiator) sends their FIRST message. Client MUST NOT render the call button until callUnlocked===true AND the call.unlocked socket event is received. No paid override exists. No bypass. The call button must be absent from the DOM, not merely disabled.
CRITICAL — Daily limits: free tier's 10 new chats/day limit, 5min audio/day, 2min video/day are all enforced server-side. Client cannot bypass them via any mechanism.

CRITICAL — Orientation grid logic: grid visibility is computed from wantToSee and whoCanDiscoverMe fields — not from orientation labels or assumptions about what orientations see each other. Ranking NEVER differentiates by gender identity or orientation.
CRITICAL — Location privacy: exact coordinates are NEVER in any API response visible to other users. Only distanceLabel string is returned on grid/profile endpoints.
CRITICAL — showOrientationPublicly defaults to false. Orientation data is never sold or used for ad targeting.
CRITICAL — AI features are ALL opt-in. Never activate automatically. Check user.aiOptInFeatures JSON for which features user has enabled.
Messaging v2: first DM opens instantly (no pending/requests state). Receiver sees conversation immediately. Old pending/requests folder model is LEGACY.
Plan enforcement: check user.plan and user.planExpiresAt on every gated endpoint. planExpiresAt null means lifetime or not set. Expired plan = free tier.
Agora calls: server generates agoraToken server-side using Agora SDK with AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE (never expose certificate to client). Token expires in 1 hour.
Payment flow: create order → client completes via Razorpay/Stripe SDK → POST /verify with signature → server verifies HMAC → activates plan/addon.
Women safety defaults on signup: verifiedUsersOnlyFilter=true for users who specify gender=woman. Do not change without explicit user action.
Moderation: AWS Rekognition or Google Vision scans all uploaded photos/clips before they are published. Explicit content → auto-reject. borderline → manual review queue.
AI features: use Anthropic Claude claude-sonnet-4-6 for icebreakers/reply suggestions/profile optimizer. Compatibility score uses a deterministic scoring function + Claude for explanation.
WebRTC legacy events (call:invite, call:answer, call:ice) kept for backwards compat. v2 calling uses Agora SDK — these events are no longer the primary call path.
